"With his bare hands...|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]], speaking of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]|''[[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons]]''}} '''''Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries that delves into the dark past of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Most notably, the series reveals how Fett became a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior, and how he was recruited by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. It is a tie-in to the video game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', which includes a virtual version of the real comic as unlockable content. The series is composed of 4 issues released between [[May]] and [[September]] [[2002]], and compiled in a [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] edition in [[January]] [[2003]].
